axes.name: category

axes.name: exactness

axes.name: concurrency

axes.name: focus
axes.meaning: Measured compromise, first-token latency, decode rate, or prefill rate.

tiers.name: exact

tiers.name: balanced

tiers.name: fast

performance_envelope.status: Proposed 10% performance envelope for paired qualification. The all-balanced2048 EXL3 candidate failed server memory admission and is held. A replacement must pass its own paired gates before becoming a recommendation; no CLI axis default is selected.
performance_envelope.protocol: Apply the mixed floor separately at C1/C2/C4/C8 and the non-code floor separately to prose and structured at each code-balanced cell. Use paired default/candidate controls with the same binary, client, prompts and capacity; record cold/warm scope, input identities, repetitions and uncertainty. Fraser median/worst TTFT and the long-prefill decode pause must be no worse than the default. A failed envelope restores a nonempty candidate hold without changing the limits.
performance_envelope.motivation: S04 gxf11 fixed-depth versus gxf12 session-adaptive measurements give prose C4 290.6 versus 377.5 tok/s (23.0% lower) and C8 381.8 versus 488.8 (21.9% lower), rejecting that fixed-depth multiple-user compromise at 10%. C1 prose 163.6 versus 167.8 is 2.5% lower and fits the proposed margin. Those C1 points are BATCH measurements, not proof against best THIN. The new current-math candidate must prove the actual mixed C1/C2-C8 envelope, memory, identity and latency objectives.
